assessment.question: Can I convert this property into two residential units?
assessment.status_reason: The assessment passed HABITA's evidence and verification checks.
assessment.conclusion_summary: A division may be possible if each new dwelling is autonomous, subject to the conditions.

statements.label: K1
statements.text: The Câmara Municipal de Cascais is the competent authority.

statements.label: K2
statements.text: Each new unit must be autonomous with its own exit.

statements.label: K3
statements.text: You stated (declared by you, not verified by HABITA): “One single-family dwelling (habitação).” You stated (declared by you, not verified by HABITA): “Two flats, one per floor, about 90 m2 each; each floor has its own street door.” You stated (declared by you, not verified by HABITA): “Single owner; not divided into fractions.”

statements.label: procedure 1
statements.text: Submit the application to the Câmara Municipal under the RJUE.

statements.label: risk 1
statements.text: Without its own exit, a unit can't be in horizontal property and the title is null.

statements.label: next action 1
statements.text: Request confirmation of the conditions from the Câmara Municipal de Cascais.

evidence.title: Regime Jurídico da Urbanização e da Edificação (RJUE)
evidence.reference: Decreto-Lei n.º 555/99, de 16 de dezembro (consolidated version) — art. 4.º
evidence.excerpt: Urban operations, including building works and alterations, are subject to municipal prior control under the RJUE (licence or prior communication, depending on the operation).

evidence.title: Regime Jurídico da Urbanização e da Edificação (RJUE)
evidence.reference: Decreto-Lei n.º 555/99, de 16 de dezembro (consolidated version) — art. 4.º (as amended)
evidence.excerpt: The use of buildings or their units, and changes to that use, are regulated by the RJUE; the applicable procedure for a change of use must be confirmed against the version in force after the Simplex Urbanístico.
evidence.version: Decreto-Lei n.º 555/99 (consolidated), reformed by Decreto-Lei n.º 10/2024

evidence.title: Código Civil — propriedade horizontal
evidence.reference: Código Civil (Decreto-Lei n.º 47 344, de 25 de novembro de 1966), arts. 1414.º–1438.º-A — art. 1415.º
evidence.excerpt: Only autonomous units can be the object of horizontal property: units that are independent, distinct and isolated from each other, with their own exit to a common part of the building or to the public way.

evidence.title: Código Civil — propriedade horizontal
evidence.reference: Código Civil (Decreto-Lei n.º 47 344, de 25 de novembro de 1966), arts. 1414.º–1438.º-A — art. 1416.º
evidence.excerpt: If the legal requirements are missing, the title constituting the horizontal property is null and the building is subject to co-ownership instead.

evidence.title: Regulamento Geral das Edificações Urbanas (RGEU)
evidence.reference: Decreto-Lei n.º 38 382, de 7 de agosto de 1951
evidence.excerpt: Dwellings must meet the RGEU's general habitability requirements (such as minimum areas, ceiling heights, natural light and ventilation); each new dwelling created by a division has to satisfy them on its own.
evidence.version: Decreto-Lei n.º 38 382/51, as amended (incl. Decreto-Lei n.º 10/2024)
